content:
A car hauler faces federal human smuggling charges after 23 people were found concealed inside vans he was transporting at a Laredo checkpoint, according to the Laredo Morning Times, citing U.S. Border Patrol's Laredo Sector.

Six of the 23 people were unaccompanied minors, the report said. The vans had their windows closed and no airflow inside. The 23 people will be processed for deportation, according to Border Patrol.

Border Patrol reported the incident Monday, October 26. The agency did not specify the identities of the people found, the precise checkpoint location, or when the attempted passage occurred, according to the Times.

Sources:

  • Laredo Morning Times, "23 people found hidden inside vans at Laredo checkpoint; driver faces charges," October 26, 2026
